panels.title: Live CDC Events — INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE

targets.rawSql:
WITH batch_seals AS
(
    SELECT generation_id, batch_id, min(verified_at) AS sealed_at
    FROM cdc_batch_commits
    WHERE generation_id IN (SELECT generation_id FROM cdc_active_generation)
    GROUP BY generation_id, batch_id
),
live_events AS
(
    SELECT e.source_table AS source_table, e.source_key AS source_key,
           e.source_version AS source_version, e.operation AS operation,
           min(s.sealed_at) AS processed_at,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(nullIf(argMin(e.source_time_ms,
               tuple(s.sealed_at, e.kafka_topic, e.kafka_partition, e.kafka_offset)), 0)), 'UTC') AS event_at
    FROM cdc_serving_records AS e
    INNER JOIN batch_seals AS s ON e.generation_id = s.generation_id AND e.batch_id = s.batch_id
    WHERE e.operation IN ('c', 'u', 'd')
    GROUP BY e.source_table, e.source_key, e.source_version, e.operation
)
SELECT countIf(operation = 'c') AS INSERT,
       countIf(operation = 'u') AS UPDATE,
       countIf(operation = 'd') AS DELETE,
       round(60000.0 * count() / nullIf(dateDiff('millisecond', $__fromTime_ms, $__toTime_ms), 0), 2)
           AS `Events / min`
FROM live_events
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(processed_at)
HAVING (SELECT count() FROM cdc_active_generation) > 0

panels.title: CDC Events Over Time

targets.rawSql:
WITH batch_seals AS
(
    SELECT generation_id, batch_id, min(verified_at) AS sealed_at
    FROM cdc_batch_commits
    WHERE generation_id IN (SELECT generation_id FROM cdc_active_generation)
    GROUP BY generation_id, batch_id
),
live_events AS
(
    SELECT e.source_table AS source_table, e.source_key AS source_key,
           e.source_version AS source_version, e.operation AS operation,
           min(s.sealed_at) AS processed_at,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(nullIf(argMin(e.source_time_ms,
               tuple(s.sealed_at, e.kafka_topic, e.kafka_partition, e.kafka_offset)), 0)), 'UTC') AS event_at
    FROM cdc_serving_records AS e
    INNER JOIN batch_seals AS s ON e.generation_id = s.generation_id AND e.batch_id = s.batch_id
    WHERE e.operation IN ('c', 'u', 'd')
    GROUP BY e.source_table, e.source_key, e.source_version, e.operation
)
SELECT $__timeInterval(processed_at) AS time,
       countIf(operation = 'c') AS INSERT,
       countIf(operation = 'u') AS UPDATE,
       countIf(operation = 'd') AS DELETE
FROM live_events
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(processed_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Latest CDC Changes

targets.rawSql:
WITH batch_seals AS
(
    SELECT generation_id, batch_id, min(verified_at) AS sealed_at
    FROM cdc_batch_commits
    WHERE generation_id IN (SELECT generation_id FROM cdc_active_generation)
    GROUP BY generation_id, batch_id
),
live_events AS
(
    SELECT e.source_table AS source_table, e.source_key AS source_key,
           e.source_version AS source_version, e.operation AS operation,
           min(s.sealed_at) AS processed_at,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(nullIf(argMin(e.source_time_ms,
               tuple(s.sealed_at, e.kafka_topic, e.kafka_partition, e.kafka_offset)), 0)), 'UTC') AS event_at
    FROM cdc_serving_records AS e
    INNER JOIN batch_seals AS s ON e.generation_id = s.generation_id AND e.batch_id = s.batch_id
    WHERE e.operation IN ('c', 'u', 'd')
    GROUP BY e.source_table, e.source_key, e.source_version, e.operation
)
SELECT event_at AS `Event Timestamp`, source_table AS `Table Name`,
       multiIf(operation = 'c', 'INSERT', operation = 'u', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE') AS Operation,
       if(source_table IN ('ClassStandings', 'CourseOfferings', 'Courses', 'DegreeLevels',
                           'DegreeRequirements', 'Degrees', 'DegreeTypes', 'Departments',
                           'Grades', 'Sessions', 'Terms'), source_key, 'Hidden') AS `Primary Key`,
       processed_at AS `Processing Timestamp`
FROM live_events
ORDER BY processed_at DESC, source_version DESC, source_table, source_key, operation
LIMIT 25

panels.title: CDC processing activity

targets.rawSql:
WITH batch_seals AS
(
    SELECT generation_id, batch_id, min(verified_at) AS sealed_at
    FROM cdc_batch_commits
    WHERE generation_id IN (SELECT generation_id FROM cdc_active_generation)
    GROUP BY generation_id, batch_id
),
live_events AS
(
    SELECT e.source_table AS source_table, e.source_key AS source_key,
           e.source_version AS source_version, e.operation AS operation,
           min(s.sealed_at) AS processed_at,
           fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64(nullIf(argMin(e.source_time_ms,
               tuple(s.sealed_at, e.kafka_topic, e.kafka_partition, e.kafka_offset)), 0)), 'UTC') AS event_at
    FROM cdc_serving_records AS e
    INNER JOIN batch_seals AS s ON e.generation_id = s.generation_id AND e.batch_id = s.batch_id
    WHERE e.operation IN ('c', 'u', 'd')
    GROUP BY e.source_table, e.source_key, e.source_version, e.operation
)
SELECT total AS `Total processed live events`,
       last_processed AS `Last processed event timestamp`,
       if(last_event_at <= last_processed,
          dateDiff('millisecond', last_event_at, last_processed), NULL) AS `Latest event-to-seal delay`
FROM
(
    SELECT count() AS total, maxOrNull(processed_at) AS last_processed,
           tupleElement(argMax(tuple(event_at),
               tuple(processed_at, source_version, source_table, source_key, operation)), 1) AS last_event_at
    FROM live_events
)
WHERE (SELECT count() FROM cdc_active_generation) > 0

panels.description: Lifetime metrics for verified live changes in the active generation. Delay compares the stored Debezium event time with the first Spark batch seal. Sampled Kafka backlog is shown under CDC progress and freshness.
